blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-modal semantic segmentation benefits from complementary sensors, but this benefit is fragile when some modalities are degraded or missing at test time. Many existing methods rely on dedicated fusion modules or multi-branch cross-modal encoders, and the fusion often becomes unreliable when modalities are absent, leading to substantial performance drops. We propose \textbf{FuseAdapt}, a parameter-efficient framework that performs fusion within the adaptation space of a frozen vision foundation model (VFM), exploring whether VFM priors can serve as an effective shared backbone for multi-modal segmentation. Instead of attaching a standalone fusion network, FuseAdapt assigns each modality a lightweight adaptation branch and performs \emph{adaptation-space fusion} by keeping Q/V low-rank adaptation private to each modality and routing only FFN low-rank residual activations across modalities inside the frozen backbone. The pretrained VFM remains fixed while modality-specific corrections and explicit cross-modal interaction are learned through the adaptation paths. To handle missing modalities, we further introduce \textbf{Predictive Modality Modeling (PMM)}, a direct representation-level objective for cross-modal redundancy. During training, PMM masks a target modality and predicts its embedding from the visible ones, supervised by a teacher target computed under full-modality input. PMM is used only during training and adds no inference-time overhead. Across three multi-modal segmentation benchmarks (MCubeS, DELIVER, MUSES), FuseAdapt consistently improves both modality-complete and modality-incomplete segmentation with a small trainable budget, yielding up to +3.01 mIoU under full modalities and +12.56 mIoU under missing modalities over prior state-of-the-art. Project page: https://devinxzhang.github.io/FuseAdapt-Page/.
blocks.zh: 多模式语义分解从互补传感器中受益,但当某些模式在试验时被退化或缺失时,这一惠益是脆弱的. 许多现有方法都依赖于专用的聚变模块或多分支的跨模式编码器,而当模式缺失时,聚变往往变得不可靠,导致大量性能下降. 我们提议\textbf{FuseAdapt},一个参数效率高的框架,在被冻结的视野基础模型(VFM)的适应空间内进行聚变,探讨VFM前身是否能够作为多模式分化的有效共享骨干. FuseAdapt不附带一个独立的聚变网络,而是指定每种模式一个轻量级适应分支,并进行\emph{适应-空间聚变},使Q/V低等适应对每种模式保持保密,并且只在被冻结的骨干内通过不同模式对FFN低等残余活化。 预先训练的VFM仍然固定不变,同时通过适应路径学习特定模式的校正和明确的跨模式互动. 为了处理缺失的模式,我们进一步引入\textbf{ 预测模式(PMM)},这是跨模式冗余的直接代表级目标。 在培训期间,PMM掩盖了一种目标模式,并预测其从可见模式上嵌入,由根据全模式输入计算出来的教师目标监督。 PMM只在培训期间使用,不增加推断时间间接费用。 FuseAdapt在三种多模式分区基准(MCubeS、DELIVER、MUSES)中,不断改进模式完成和模式不完成的分区,其可培训预算较小,在完全模式下达到+3.01 mIoU,在缺失模式下达到+12.56 mIoU,优于以前的先进水平。 项目网页:https://devinxzhang.github.io/FuseAdapt-Page/.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Scene understanding often benefits from combining multiple sensing modalities ( Huang et al., 2022 ; Jia et al., 2023 ; Park et al., 2017 ; Zhang et al., 2018 ) .
RGB ( Wei et al., 2024 ; Zhang and Tan, 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2025a ; Yuan et al., 2026a ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2024b ; Zhang and Chen, 2023 ) , depth ( Cao et al., 2021 ; Song et al., 2022 ; Ying and Chuah, 2022 ) , LiDAR ( Yan et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023 ) , and event streams ( Xia et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2021a ; Li et al., 2025b ) provide complementary cues about appearance, geometry, and motion.
In practice, however, this multi-sensor benefit is fragile: a modality may be noisy ( Yang et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026b ) , degraded, spatially imperfect, or unavailable at inference time.
Such cases are common in autonomous driving ( Caesar et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2026 ) and embodied settings ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , where illumination, weather ( Du et al., 2026 ; Teng et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , texture, sensor failure, or calibration conditions ( Yuan et al., 2025a ) can affect sensors unequally.
A practical multi-modal segmentation model should therefore work in two settings: modality-complete semantic segmentation (MCSS), where all modalities are available and should be fused effectively, and modality-incomplete semantic segmentation (MISS), where only a subset is available and the model should remain reliable.
blocks.zh:
场景理解常得益于多种感知方式的结合(黄等人,2022;贾等人,2023;朴等人,2017;张等人,2018).
RGB (Wei等人, 2024年;张和谭,. 2025年;张等人,2026年;张等人,2024年a;李等人,2025年a;袁等人,2026年a; 周等,2026;张等,2024b;张等,2023),深度. (Cao等人,2021年;Song等人,2022年;Ying和Chuah,2022年),LiDAR (Yan等人,2022年;Wang等人,2022年;Li等人,2023年),以及事件流. (Xia等人,2023年;Zhang等人,2021年a;Li等人,2025年b)提供了外观,几何和运动的互补提示.
然而,在实践中,这种多传感器的好处是脆弱的:一种方式可能很吵(Yang等人,2026a); Yang等人, 2026b), 退化, 空间不完善, 或推论时间不可用.
这类案例常见于自主驾驶(Caesar等人,2020年;Li等人,2026年)和内含环境(Wang等人,2024年),其中照明,天气(Du等人,2026年;Teng等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年),纹理,传感器故障,或校准条件(Yuan等人,2025年a年)会不平等地影响传感器.
因此,实用的多模式分解模式应在两种情况下发挥作用:模式-完整的语义分解(MCSS),所有模式都可以使用,应当有效连接;模式-不完整语义分解(MISS),只有子集可用,该模式应当保持可靠。

Figure 1: Comparison of multi-modal fusion strategies.
(a) Separate encoders with mid-level fusion can replicate backbone computation across modalities.
(b) Shared-encoder or late-fusion designs reduce this cost, but can make fusion depend strongly on the dominant or cleanest modality.
(c) FuseAdapt keeps the VFM frozen and performs cross-modal exchange through trainable adaptation paths.
Right: MCSS on MCubeS, where FuseAdapt improves mIoU across modality combinations.
blocks.zh:
图1:多式联运战略比较。
(a) 具有中层聚变的单独编码器可跨模式复制主干计算。
(b) 共享编码器或晚聚变设计可降低这一成本,但能使聚变严重依赖主导或最清洁的模式。
(c) FuseAdapt保持VFM的冻结,并通过可训练的适应路径进行跨模式的交换。
右:MCSS在MCubeS上,其中FuseAdapt改进mIoU跨模式组合.

blocks.en:
Existing multi-modal segmentation methods often trade off modality-specific modeling, compactness, and robustness.
Separate-encoder designs fuse intermediate features from different modalities ( Broedermann et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023a ) , but can increase parameters and computation as the number of sensors grows.
RGB-centric methods treat RGB as the main input and use other modalities as auxiliary cues ( Zhang et al., 2023b ) , which can be limiting when RGB is degraded or absent.
Shared-encoder and late-fusion methods improve compactness ( Zheng et al., 2024c ; Zheng et al., 2024b ) , but their shared stream can favor the most informative or easiest modality, making the contribution of other sensors less stable.
For missing-modality robustness, recent methods go beyond modality dropout by using text anchors ( Zheng et al., 2024b ) , subset consistency ( Zheng et al., 2024c ; Zheng et al., 2024a ) , or modality regularization ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) .
These strategies provide indirect supervision for dense prediction: text anchors are coarse, and subset consistency can be affected by cross-modal mismatch.
blocks.zh:
现有的多种模式分割方法往往与模式特定模式、紧凑性和稳健性互换。
分离编码器从不同模式设计引信中间特性(Bromedermann等人,2023年;张等人,2023年a年),但随着传感器数量的增加,可以增加参数和计算.
RGB中心方法将RGB作为主要输入,并使用其他模式作为辅助提示(Zhang等人,2023b),当RGB退化或缺失时,这些模式可能会受到限制.
共享编码器和延迟聚变方法提高了紧凑性(Zheng等人,2024c;Zheng等人,2024b),但其共享流可以倾向于信息最丰富或最简便的方式,使得其他传感器的贡献更不稳定.
对于缺失模式稳健性,最近的方法不仅限于模式退出,而是使用文本锚(郑等人,2024b),子集一致性(郑等人,2024c;郑等人,2024a),或模式正规化(郑等人,2025年)。
这些策略为密集预测提供了间接监督:文本锚地粗糙,子集一致性可能受到跨模式不匹配的影响.

blocks.en: We study how to separate sensor-specific adaptation from cross-sensor communication within a shared frozen backbone. FuseAdapt keeps modality-specific Q/V low-rank residuals private and restricts receiver-conditioned, token-wise exchange to FFN low-rank residual activations (Fig. 1 (c)). The frozen dense FFN transformation stays on the receiving stream, while routing is normalized over the available sensors. We call this constraint on the trainable communication path adaptation-space fusion . The exchanged tensors remain intermediate features; the contribution is the separation of private attention adaptation and cross-modal residual communication, rather than a new tensor domain or the individual use of LoRA and routing. A shared VFM supplies the pretrained representation, and controlled experiments with MiT backbones test whether the benefit depends on that representation.
blocks.zh: 我们研究如何在共享的冷冻骨干内将传感器特定适应与交叉传感器通信区分开来. FuseAdapt保留特定模式的Q/V低级残留,并限制接收器有条件的,按物序交换到FFN低级残留激活(图1(c)). 冷冻稠密的FFN变换停留在接收流上,而路由则在可用的传感器上正常化. 我们称这种限制为可训练的通信路径适应-空间聚变。 交换的升温器仍然是中间特征;其贡献是将私人注意力的适应和跨模式残余通信分开,而不是一个新的升温器域或单独使用LORA和路由. 共享的VFM提供预先训练的表示方式,并使用MiT骨干进行控制实验,测试这种表示方式是否有利。

blocks.en:
To handle missing modalities, we introduce Predictive Modality Modeling (PMM) (Fig. 2 (c)).
PMM masks a target modality during training and predicts its representation from the visible modalities, supervised by a teacher target computed under full-modality input.
PMM applies the joint-embedding predictive principle at modality level: target-specific queries predict an unobserved sensor’s latent representation from visible context. Its EMA teacher supplies a temporally smoothed, stop-gradient target. After projection onto a common token grid, each query can attend to all visible positions rather than imposing same-index visible-to-target regression. This does not remove the common-grid requirement of routing and averaging. The teacher and predictor are used only during training.
blocks.zh:
为了处理缺失的模式,我们采用了预测模式(图2(c))。
PMM在培训期间掩盖了一种目标模式,并用可见模式预测其表现方式,由根据全模式输入计算出来的教师目标监督。
PMM在模式层面应用了联合嵌入预测原则:针对特定目标的查询从可见上下文中预测出一个看不见的传感器的潜在表现。 它的EMA教师提供一个暂时平滑的,停止升级的目标. 在投影到一个共同的令牌网格后,每个查询都可以处理所有可见位置,而不是强制进行同指数的可见对目标回归. 这并不能消除路线和平均值的共同网要求。 教师和预测器只在培训期间使用。

blocks.en:
Figure 2: Comparison of designs for robustness under missing modalities (MISS).
(a) Semantic-anchor methods align modality features to text embeddings, but text anchors can be coarse for pixel-level segmentation.
(b) Semantic-consistency methods enforce agreement across different modality subsets, but such constraints can be affected by cross-modal mismatch.
(c) Predictive Modality Modeling (PMM) casts MISS training as conditional representation prediction. Learnable query tokens aggregate cues from visible modalities to predict a missing-modality embedding, improving MISS performance on DELIVER and MUSES.
blocks.zh:
图 2: 缺失模式下稳健性设计比较(MISS).
(a) 语义-定点法使模式特性与文本嵌入一致,但文本锚可以粗糙地用于像素级分割。
(b) 语义一致性方法在不同模式子集之间强制执行协议,但这种限制可能受跨模式不匹配的影响。
(c) 预测模式模型化(PMM)将MISS培训作为有条件的表示预测。 可学习的查询符号从可见模式中汇总提示,以预测缺失模式嵌入,提高MISS在DELIVER和MUSES上的性能.

blocks.en:
We evaluate FuseAdapt on MCubeS ( Liang et al., 2022 ) , DELIVER ( Zhang et al., 2023b ) , and MUSES ( Brödermann et al., 2024 ) under both MCSS and MISS protocols.
FuseAdapt yields up to +3.01 mIoU under full modalities and +12.56 mIoU under missing modalities over prior state-of-the-art, with ablations isolating the contributions of modality-specific adaptation, routed cross-modal exchange, PMM, and the choice of frozen VFM.
Our contributions are: • FuseAdapt separates modality-private Q/V adaptation from receiver-conditioned cross-modal exchange restricted to FFN low-rank residual activations, with routing adjusted to the visible sensor subset. • PMM trains missing-modality robustness through target-conditioned latent prediction. Controls distinguish its prediction target from output distillation and generic fused-feature matching. • Experiments on three benchmarks, same-backbone PEFT and information-flow controls support the design. We additionally characterize its inference cost and the scope of its robustness.
blocks.zh:
我们用MCubeS评估FuseAdapt (Liang等人,2022年),DELIVER(Zhang等人,2023年b),以及MUSES(Brödermann等人,2024年)在MCSS和MISS协议之下.
FuseAdapt在全部模式下产生最高+3.01 mIoU,在先前最先进的模式下缺失的+12.56 mIoU,同时将特定模式的适应、路由式交叉交换、PMM和选择冷冻VFM的贡献隔离开来.
我们的贡献是: • FuseAdapt将模式-私有Q/V适应与接收器条件的交叉模式交换分离,仅限于FFN低级残余激活,其路由调整为可见传感器子集. • PMM通过目标条件下的潜在预测,使模式不完善。 控制将它的预测目标与输出蒸馏和通用的引信环境匹配区分开来. • 关于三个基准的实验、同背骨PEFT和信息流控制支持设计。 我们还对其推论的成本及其稳健性的范围作了说明。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Multi-Modal Semantic Segmentation Multi-modal semantic segmentation uses complementary RGB ( Wei et al., 2024 ; Zhang and Tan, 2025 ; Qian et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2022 ; Deng et al., 2020 ) , depth ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Ying and Chuah, 2022 ; Song et al., 2022 ; Cao et al., 2021 ; Park et al., 2017 ) , LiDAR ( Li et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Zhuang et al., 2021 ; Yan et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2022 ) , thermal ( Hui et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023c ; Zhang et al., 2021b ; Wu et al., 2022 ) , and event cues ( Xia et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2021a ; Jia et al., 2023 ) .
Prior work often uses fixed modality pairs such as RGB-depth ( Ying and Chuah, 2022 ; Song et al., 2022 ) , RGB-centric fusion ( Zhang et al., 2023b ) , or shared-backbone fusion with auxiliary alignment ( Zheng et al., 2024b ; Zheng et al., 2024c ; Zheng et al., 2024a ) .
In contrast, FuseAdapt keeps a frozen VFM and performs cross-modal exchange through trainable adaptation paths, avoiding a standalone fusion network.
blocks.zh:
多模块语义分解 多模式语义分解使用互补的RGB(Wei等人,2024年;张和谭,). 2025; Q等, 2024; 张等, 2022; 邓等, 2020.), 深度(王等, 2020; 殷和楚. 2022; Song et al., 2022; Cao et al., 2021; Park et al., 2017.), LiDAR (Li et al., 2022; Li et al., 2023; Zhuang et al., 2021; Yan et al., 2022; Wang et al., 2022), 热 (Hui等人,2023年;Zhang等人,2023年c;Zhang等人,2021年b;Wu等人,2022年),以及事件提示(Xia等人,2023年;Zhang等人,2021年a;Jia等人,2023年).
先前的工作经常使用RGB深度(Ying and Chuah, 2022;Song et al., 2022),RGB中心聚变(Zhang等人, 2023b)等固定模式配对,或者使用辅助对齐的共享背骨聚变(Zheng等人, 2024b;Zheng等人, 2024c;Zheng等人, 2024a).
相比之下,FuseAdapt保存着一个冷冻的VFM,并通过可训练的适应路径进行跨模式的交换,避免独立的聚变网络.

blocks.en: Missing or Degraded Modalities Existing approaches use modality dropout, cross-modal distillation, and consistency regularization ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2024b ; Zheng et al., 2024c ; Zheng et al., 2024a ) . CRM ( Shin et al., 2024 ) combines complementary RGB-thermal masking with clean-to-masked self-distillation; M3L ( Maheshwari et al., 2024 ) uses a full-modality teacher to supervise masked-modality segmentation. PMM instead conditions on a designated missing sensor and predicts its full-context latent representation. This follows the latent-context prediction principle of I-JEPA ( Assran et al., 2023 ) , applied to modalities rather than image regions. Masking, EMA, and teacher–student optimization are established mechanisms; the prediction target and modality conditioning distinguish our objective.
blocks.zh: 失踪或有辱人格的方式 现有方法使用模式退出、跨模式蒸馏和一致性规范(Liu等人,2024年;Wang等人,2023年;Zheng等人,2024年b;Zheng等人,2024年c;Zheng等人,2024年a). CRM(Shin等人,2024年)将补充性RGB-热掩体与清洁到大规模自我沉淀相结合;M3L(Maheshwari等人,2024年)使用全模式教师监督掩体模式分化。 而PMM则在指定的缺失传感器上设置条件,并预测其全文本潜在表现. 这遵循了I-JEPA(Asran等人,2023年)的潜在文字预测原则,该原则适用于模式而不是图像区域。 Masking、EMA和师生优化是既定的机制;预测目标和模式调节使我们的目标不同。

blocks.en: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation and Fusion Prompt tuning, adapters, and LoRA reduce the cost of adapting pretrained models ( Lester et al., 2021 ; Jia et al., 2022 ; Houlsby et al., 2019 ; Chen et al., 2022 ; Hu et al., 2022 ; Yan et al., 2025 ) . StitchFusion ( Li et al., 2024 ) transfers dense features between encoder streams through MultiAdapters. MLE-SAM ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) combines modality-specific LoRA experts and routing with multi-scale feature/head fusion. MoLE ( Wu et al., 2024 ) composes task/concept LoRAs within a single stream. Concurrent M4-SAM ( Liu et al., 2026 ) combines modality-dispatched convolutional experts with gated feature fusion for RGB-D video, while MILE ( Muralidhara et al., 2026 ) selects isolated continual-task experts. FuseAdapt instead keeps Q/V residuals private and restricts directed source-to-receiver communication to FFN low-rank residuals among currently visible sensors. Section 4.4 tests this constraint against routing all low-rank paths or complete FFN features.

MLE-SAM(Zhu等人,2024年)结合了特定模式的LORA专家以及路由与多尺度的特征/头聚变. MOLE(Wu等人,2024年)在单流内组成任务/概念LORAs. 同时的M4-SAM (Liu et al., 2026) 将模式派式的革命专家与为 RGB-D 视频配门的特性聚变相结合,而MILE(Muralidhara et al., 2026)则选择孤立的连续任务专家. FuseAdapt则保持Q/V残基的私密性,并限制与FFN低级残基在目前可见传感器中的定向源对接收器通信. 第4.4节检验了这种对所有低等级路径或完整的FFN特征的路由限制.

blocks.en: 3 Proposed Method
blocks.zh: 3 拟议方法

blocks.en: We address robust multi-modal semantic segmentation in two regimes: modality-complete semantic segmentation (MCSS), where all modalities are available, and modality-incomplete semantic segmentation (MISS), where only a subset is available at test time. Our goal is to adapt a frozen vision foundation model (VFM) into a multi-modal learner that can fuse available modalities with a small trainable budget and learn redundancy for missing-modality robustness.
blocks.zh: 我们处理两种制度中的强力多式语义分割问题:模式-完全语义分割(所有模式都可以使用)和模式-不完全语义分割(MISS),在试验时只有一个子集。 我们的目标是将冻结的愿景基础模型(VFM)改造成一个多模式学习者,能够将现有模式与少量可培训预算结合起来,并学习冗余性以弥补模式缺失。

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 3 , the input contains four aligned image-like modalities of the same scene: RGB 𝐑 ∈ ℝ h × w × 3 \mathbf{R}\in\mathbb{R}^{h\times w\times 3} , depth 𝐃 ∈ ℝ h × w × C D \mathbf{D}\in\mathbb{R}^{h\times w\times C^{D}} , LiDAR projection 𝐋 ∈ ℝ h × w × C L \mathbf{L}\in\mathbb{R}^{h\times w\times C^{L}} , and event stack 𝐄 ∈ ℝ h × w × C E \mathbf{E}\in\mathbb{R}^{h\times w\times C^{E}} , with pixel labels 𝐘 \mathbf{Y} over K K classes. Following ( Zhang et al., 2023b ) , we set C D = C L = C E = 3 C^{D}=C^{L}=C^{E}=3 and feed all modalities as image-like inputs to a shared frozen VFM.

blocks.en: FuseAdapt has two components. First, an adaptation-space fusion design (§ 3.1 ) performs fusion in the adaptation space of the frozen VFM. Each modality has lightweight trainable adaptation paths, and cross-modal exchange is implemented by routing FFN low-rank residual activations across modalities inside Transformer blocks. The pretrained backbone remains fixed. Second, Predictive Modality Modeling (PMM) improves MISS by training the model to predict a masked modality representation from visible modalities, using a teacher target computed with full-modality context. PMM is used only during training and discarded at inference.
blocks.zh: FuseAdapt有两个组件. 首先,一种适应-空间聚变设计(§3.1)在冷冻VFM的适应空间中进行聚变. 每种模式都有轻量级可训练适应路径,跨模式交换是通过在变形器区块内跨模式的路由式FFN低级剩余激活来实现的. 训练有素的骨干仍然固定。 第二,预测性模式模型(PMM)改进了MISS,方法是通过培训模型从可见模式中预测一种蒙面模式的表示,使用一个以全模式背景计算的教师目标。 PMM只在训练期间使用,在推断时被丢弃.

blocks.zh: 3.1 适应空间融合

blocks.en: We realize adaptation-space fusion through modality-specific low-rank adaptation paths inside the frozen VFM, with cross-modal exchange implemented by routed FFN low-rank residual activations. We keep self-attention adaptation modality-specific to preserve sensor-specific correction, and place cross-modal exchange in the FFN adaptation path.

blocks.en: 3.2 Predictive Modality Modeling
blocks.zh: 3.2 预测性模式

blocks.en: While adaptation-space fusion handles full-modality inputs, MISS also requires the model to behave reliably when some modalities are absent. PMM addresses this by adding a representation-level prediction objective during training. Given visible modalities, the model predicts the representation of a masked target modality, supervised by a teacher target computed with full-modality context. This encourages cross-modal redundancy beyond segmentation supervision alone.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: Datasets We evaluate on three multi-modal segmentation benchmarks covering both modality-complete semantic segmentation (MCSS) and modality-incomplete semantic segmentation (MISS). DELIVER ( Zhang et al., 2023b ) contains synchronized RGB, depth, LiDAR, and event inputs for 25-class urban-scene segmentation, with 3,983/2,005/1,897 train/val/test samples and diverse adverse conditions such as fog, rain, night, blur, exposure changes, and LiDAR jitter ( Yuan et al., 2026b ) . MCubeS ( Liang et al., 2022 ) contains 20-class material segmentation with RGB, NIR, DoLP, and AoLP modalities ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , using 302/96/102 train/val/test samples. MUSES ( Brödermann et al., 2024 ) provides synchronized frame-camera, event-camera, and MEMS-LiDAR data with 2D panoptic annotations, enabling evaluation with heterogeneous sensors.
blocks.zh: 数据集 我们评价三种多模式分解基准,包括模式-完整的语义分解和模式-不完整语义分解。 DELIVER(Zhang等人,2023年b)包含同步的RGB,深度,LiDAR,以及25级城市-场景分区的活动输入,有3,983/2,005/1,897次列车/val/测试样本以及雾,雨,夜,模糊,暴露变化等多种不利条件和LiDAR jitter(袁等人,2026年b). MCubeS. blocks.en: Implementation Details We use AdamW and train on A5000 GPUs: 8 GPUs for DELIVER and 4 GPUs for MCubeS/MUSES. Batch size is 1 per GPU for DELIVER and 4 for MCubeS/MUSES. The initial learning rate is 4 × 10 − 4 4\times 10^{-4} for DELIVER/MUSES and 3.5 × 10 − 4 3.5\times 10^{-4} for MCubeS, with a 10-epoch warm-up at 0.1 × \times . We train for 200 epochs on DELIVER/MUSES and 500 epochs on MCubeS. Input resolutions are 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 for DELIVER/MUSES and 512 × 512 512\times 512 for MCubeS. We use standard augmentations, including random resizing (0.5–2.0), horizontal flipping, color jitter, blur, and random cropping. FuseAdapt uses rank 8 for DELIVER and MCubeS, and 4 for MUSES. We use DINOv2-B for DELIVER/MCubeS and DINOv2-S for MUSES ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) as frozen VFM backbones.

blocks.en: Evaluation Protocol We report two settings. In MCSS, all modalities are available at training and inference, measuring full-modality fusion. In MISS, the model is trained with all modalities and evaluated on modality subsets at inference, measuring robustness when sensors are unavailable.
blocks.zh: 评价协议 我们报告两个设置。 在MCSS中,所有模式都可以通过培训和推论,测量全模式聚变. 在MISS中,该模型接受了所有模式的培训,并评估了推论中的模式子集,在传感器不可用时测量稳健性。

blocks.en: Comparison Context Cross-backbone headline comparisons reflect both the method and the pretrained representation. We separately report internally trained controls with frozen MiT-B0/B2 and a common SegFormer decoder ( Xie et al., 2021 ) , recipe, and checkpoint rule (Section 4.4 ). DINOv2-S was chosen on MUSES to keep the trainable budget comparable to MiT-B0 baselines, not to match backbone capacity. A matched DINOv2-B run reaches 80.16 versus 77.28 with DINOv2-S (Appendix A ).

blocks.en: 4.1 Modality-Complete Semantic Segmentation (MCSS) Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 模块-完成语义分解(MCSS)结果

blocks.en:
We first evaluate MCSS on MCubeS, MUSES, and DELIVER, where all modalities are available during training and inference.
As shown in Tabs. 1 , 2 , and 3 ,
FuseAdapt achieves the best reported mean performance among the compared methods on all three benchmarks with a small trainable budget.
On MCubeS, FuseAdapt obtains 57.62 mIoU with all four modalities (RADN) and 56.30 mean mIoU, compared with 53.29 for StitchFusion and 52.43 for MAGIC.
On DELIVER, it achieves 64.97 mean mIoU, outperforming StitchFusion (63.68) and Any2Seg (64.18).
On MUSES, it reaches 76.14 mean mIoU, improving over the prior reported results across all modality combinations.
These results indicate that adapting a frozen VFM with modality-specific paths and routed adaptation exchange provides effective full-modality fusion.
blocks.zh:
我们首先对MCSS进行关于MCubeS、MUSES和DELIVER的评价,在培训和推论期间可以提供所有模式。
如标签1、2和3所示,
FuseAdapt在三个基准的比较方法中实现了所报告的最佳平均业绩,但可培训预算不多。
在MCubeS上,FuseAdapt获得57.62 mIoU,所有四种模式(RADN)和56.30 mIoU,而StitchFusion为53.29,MAGIC为52.43.
在DELIVER上,它实现了64.97 平均mIoU,表现优于StitchFusion(63.68)和Any2Seg(64.18).
在MUSES上,它达到了76.14 平均MIOU,比以前所报告的所有方式组合的结果有所改善。
这些结果表明,采用特定方式调整冷冻的VFM和路由化的适应交换可提供有效的全模式聚变。

blocks.en: 4.2 Modality-Incomplete Semantic Segmentation (MISS) Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 语义分裂(MISS)

blocks.en:
We next evaluate MISS, where models are trained with all modalities and tested on arbitrary modality subsets.
As shown in Tabs. 5 , 4 , and 6 , FuseAdapt improves performance across a broad range of missing-modality settings.
On MCubeS, FuseAdapt achieves 52.89 mean mIoU, outperforming MAGIC (38.00) and Zheng et al. (41.64).
On DELIVER, it obtains 56.22 mean mIoU, compared with 45.04 for Any2Seg, 44.78 for MAGIC++, and 43.91 for StitchFusion.
On MUSES, it reaches 61.30 mean mIoU with 3.29M trainable parameters, outperforming the reported baselines.
The gains across different modality subsets suggest that the learned representation remains useful under changing sensor availability.
Fig. 4 shows qualitative MISS results on DELIVER.
With only RGB (Row 1) or RGB+LiDAR (Row 2), FuseAdapt produces cleaner predictions and more coherent scene layouts than CMNeXt and StitchFusion, especially in challenging night or fog cases where baselines show larger region-level errors.
blocks.zh:
接下来我们评价MISS,其中模型接受所有模式的培训,并测试任意模式子集.
如Tabs. 5、4和6所示,FuseAdapt改进了各种缺失模式设置的性能。
在MCubeS上,FuseAdapt实现52.89平均值mIoU,表现优于MAGIC(38.00)和郑等人(41.64).
在DELIVER上,它获得56.22 平均mIoU,而Any2Seg为45.04,MAGIC++为44.78,StitchFusion为43.91.
在MUSES上,它达到61.30平均值mIoU,具有3.29M可训练参数,超过了所报告的基线。
不同模式子集的收益表明,在变化中的传感器可用性中,学到的表述仍然有用。
图4显示了DELIVER系统的质量结果。
由于只有RGB(Row 1)或RGB+LiDAR(Row 2),FuseAdapt产生比CMNeXt和StitchFusion更清洁的预测和更加连贯的场景布局,特别是在基准显示更大区域级错误的具有挑战性的夜间或雾中.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: We ablate FuseAdapt and PMM under the same training recipe and also examine the effect of changing the frozen VFM backbone.
blocks.zh: 根据同样的训练方法,我们放弃FuseAdapt和PMM,并审查改变冻结的VFM主干线的效果。

blocks.en:
FuseAdapt Variants (MCSS) Tabs. 1 and 2 compare variants within the same frozen-VFM framework.
Without FuseAdapt, the model uses naive aggregation of per-modality features and performs worse.
Shared FuseAdapt improves performance but uses one adaptation path for all modalities, limiting modality-specific correction.
Separate FuseAdapt uses modality-specific paths without routed exchange; it improves over Shared on MCubeS, while their MUSES DINOv2-S means are similar. Full FuseAdapt performs best in both tables.
This supports the contribution of both modality-specific adaptation and routed adaptation exchange.
blocks.zh:
FuseAdapt variats(MCSS) Tabs. 1和2在同一冷冻-VFM框架内比较变体.
没有FuseAdapt,该模型使用天真地集成的通式特性,表现更差.
共享的FuseAdapt可以提高性能,但对所有模式使用一个适应路径,限制特定模式的校正.
分离引信 适应使用没有路由交换的特定模式路径;它在MCubeS上改进过共享,而他们的MUSES DINOv2-S手段相似. FuseAdapt在两个表格中表现最好。
这有助于特定模式的适应和路由式的适应交流。

blocks.en:
PMM Variants (MISS) Tab. 5 evaluates PMM variants under MISS on MCubeS.
Removing the predictor or replacing it with a linear predictor reduces mean mIoU from 52.89 to 43.67 and 49.71, respectively.
This shows that the representation-level prediction objective is important, and that the query-based predictor is more effective than a simple linear prediction head.
Additional ablations, including FuseAdapt rank and scalability, are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
PMM变体(MISS) Tab. 5在MCubeS上评价MISS下的PMM变体.
移除预测器或用线性预测器取代它分别使mIoU从52.89降至43.67和49.71。
这表明表示级预测目标很重要,基于查询的预测器比简单的线性预测头更有效.
补充材料中还提供了附加材料,包括FuseAdapt等级和可扩展性。

blocks.en:
Additional VFMs To examine sensitivity to the frozen VFM choice, we keep the full pipeline fixed and replace DINOv2-B with EVA-CLIP-B ( Sun et al., 2023 ) and NeCo-B ( Pariza et al., 2024 ) on MCubeS under MCSS.
FuseAdapt achieves 56.02 mIoU with EVA-CLIP-B and 56.28 with NeCo-B, compared with 57.62 using DINOv2-B.
Although absolute performance depends on the chosen VFM, the method remains competitive across different frozen backbones, reducing dependence on a single pretrained model.
blocks.zh:
额外的VFM 为了检查对冷冻的VFM选择的敏感性,我们保持全管固定,并将DINOv2-B替换为MCSS下的MCubeS上的EVA-CLIP-B(Sun等人,2023年)和NeCo-B(Pariza等人,2024年).
FuseAdapt用EVA-CLIP-B实现56.02 mIoU,用NeCo-B实现56.28,而使用DINov2-B的则为57.62.
虽然绝对性能取决于所选择的VFM,但该方法在不同的冷冻骨干之间仍然具有竞争力,减少了对单一的预训模型的依赖.

blocks.en: 4.4 Controlled Comparisons
blocks.zh: 4.4 控制下的比较

blocks.en: Backbone and recipe controls. On MUSES with frozen MiT-B0, FuseAdapt obtains 57.54 mIoU versus 49.47 for Deep Prompt, 53.56 for Shared LoRA, and 54.80 for Adapter. These internal controls use the same decoder, split, augmentation, optimizer, schedule, PMM, and checkpoint rule, with 2.95/2.81/2.95/2.94M trainable parameters, respectively. External MiT-B0 references MAGIC and Any2Seg obtain 49.02/50.00. With MiT-B2, FuseAdapt obtains 70.60, compared with 58.28/55.36/53.40/59.36 for CMNeXt/MAGIC/StitchFusion/CHARM. External results share the backbone family but are not all recipe-matched; Appendix A gives definitions and protocols.
blocks.zh: 后骨和食谱控制. 在MUSES上冷冻的MiT-B0上,FuseAdapt获得57.54 mIoU对深速率49.47,共享LORA53.56,适配器54.80。 这些内部控制使用相同的解码器,分解,增强,优化,调度,PMM,以及检查站规则,使用2.95/2.81-2.95/2.94. 管理人员 可培训参数。 外部MiT-B0参考MAGIC和Any2Seg获得49.02/50. 随着MiT-B2,FuseAdapt获得70.60,而CMNEXt/MAGIC/StitchFusion/CHARM则获得58.28/55.36/53.40/59.36. 外部结果共享骨干家族,但并非全部配制;附录A给出了定义和协议.

blocks.en: Alternative fusion mechanisms. Table 11 further compares fusion designs on MCubeS using DINOv2-B and the same segmentation decoder. Frozen feature averaging and concatenation obtain 51.16 and 52.42 mIoU, while token-attention fusion obtains 52.79. Late-logit fusion with private low-rank adaptation reaches 54.55, compared with 57.62 for FuseAdapt. These controls distinguish adaptation-space exchange from simply combining frozen representations or independently adapted predictions. Separate adaptation without routing reaches 56.09, narrowing the gap but remaining below the full model.
blocks.zh: 替代聚变机制. 表11进一步比较了使用DINOv2-B和同一分解编码器的MCubeS上的聚变设计. 冷冻特性平均和凝聚得到51.16和52.42 mIoU,而信使聚变得到52.79. 晚期与私人低等级适应的融合达到54.55,而FuseAdapt则达到57.62. 这些控制将适应-空间交换与简单地结合冷冻表示或独立调整的预测区分开来. 没有路线的单独改造达到56.09,缩小了差距,但仍低于全模型.

blocks.en: Where should information cross modalities? Dense-feature routing keeps Q/V private but mixes complete FFN features; All-path routed LoRA routes Q/V and FFN residuals. Both retain the backbone and decoder of the corresponding setting. FuseAdapt outperforms these alternatives on MCubeS and MUSES (Table 7 ), supporting the separation of private attention adaptation and residual-only exchange. These are internal mechanism controls, not reproductions of complete prior systems.
blocks.zh: 信息应在哪里交叉模式? dense-feature routing 保持Q/V的私密性,但混合了完整的FFN特征; All-path routed LoRA routes Q/V和FFN 残基. 两者都保留了相应的设置的骨干和解码器. FuseAdapt在MCubeS和MUSES上超过了这些替代品(表7),支持私人注意力适应和仅余交换的分离. 这些是内部机制控制,而不是复制完整的先前系统。

blocks.en: Prediction versus generic distillation. With the same backbone, masking, EMA teacher, segmentation supervision, and schedule, output-logit KD and fused-feature KD obtain 49.84 and 50.57 MISS mean mIoU on MCubeS, versus 52.89 for PMM. PMM improves output KD in all 15 nonempty subsets and fused-feature KD in 14/15. Removing EMA from the query predictor gives 50.59; the original per-token regressor gives 49.71. These controls support the target-conditioned prediction objective beyond generic full-to-partial matching. Table 8 summarizes the objectives; Appendix B gives every subset.

blocks.en: 4.5 Robustness and Deployment Cost
blocks.zh: 4.5 能力和部署费用

blocks.en: Scope of robustness. On DELIVER’s ten predefined weather/degradation conditions, FuseAdapt obtains 67.36 mean mIoU versus 67.19 for Any2Seg, leading in eight conditions but trailing at night and under-exposure. In a separate MCubeS latent-prediction test, shifting the visible sensors together by 16 pixels relative to the masked target reduces cosine similarity by 0.00051 for the query predictor versus 0.01636 for per-token regression. The linear model has higher clean cosine; the evidence concerns lower shift sensitivity, not universally better reconstruction or arbitrary sensor misalignment. Appendix C provides both protocols and full tables.
blocks.zh: 稳健性的范围。 在DELIVER的十种预设天气/退化条件下,FuseAdapt得到67.36 mIoU对Any2Seg的67.19,在八个条件下领先,但晚间落后和接触不足。 在单独的MCubeS潜伏预测测试中,与被遮蔽的目标相比,由16像素一起移动可见的传感器,使查询预测器的余弦相似度降低0.00051,而每盘反射为0.01636。 线性模型具有更高的清洁余弦;证据涉及更低的转向敏感性,而不是普遍更好的重建或任意的传感器错位. 附 录 C提供协议和完整表格。

blocks.en: Full-context target reliability. A full-input EMA target is useful on average but is not a per-sample oracle. Across 1,428 MCubeS image/subset pairs, comprising 102 images and 14 proper subsets, full-input predictions improve per-image mIoU by 4.44 on average and outperform partial-input predictions in 81.72% of pairs. PMM nevertheless uses detached latent representations, rather than segmentation pseudo-labels, as supervision. This analysis characterizes the benefit and limitation of the full-context assumption: additional sensors usually provide useful context under the evaluated distribution, but can also introduce misleading information. See Appendix B.1 for details.
blocks.zh: 全文目标可靠性. 完全输入的EMA目标平均有用,但不是每个样本的甲骨文. 1,428个魔方 S影像/子集对,包含102张影像和14个适当的子集,全输入预测平均将每个图像mIoU改进4.44,超过81.72%对偶的部分输入预测. 然而,PMM使用离散的潜在表示,而不是分化伪标签作为监督。 这一分析定性了完整文字假设的好处和局限性:附加传感器通常在被评价的分布下提供有用的上下文,但也能够引入误导信息. 详情见附录B.1。

blocks.en: End-to-end efficiency. On an idle H100, at 1024 2 1024^{2} , batch 1, FP32, with 20 warm-ups and 100 timed runs, three-modality MiT-B0 FuseAdapt takes 21.05 ms versus 19.63 for CMNeXt and 26.69 for StitchFusion. It retains 3.91M unique deployed parameters and removes both PMM components. Parameter efficiency does not imply lowest latency or memory: Any2Seg and MAGIC are faster in this profile. Appendix D reports all measured costs and identifies reconstructed inference graphs.
blocks.zh: 端对端效率. 在闲置的H100上,10:24 2 1024^{2},第1批,FP32,有20个热身和100个定时跑道,三种模式的MiT-B0 FuseAdapt需要21.05 mss,而CMNeXt需要19.63 ms,StitchFusion需要26.69 ms. 它保留了3.91M独特的部署参数,并移除了PMM的两个组件. 参数效率并不意味着最低延迟或内存: Any2Seg和MAGIC在此配置中速度更快. 附 录 D报告所有测量成本,并找出重建的推论图表。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和结论

blocks.en: FuseAdapt separates modality-private attention adaptation from cross-modal exchange through FFN low-rank residuals. PMM complements this design with target-conditioned missing-modality latent prediction. Same-backbone controls support both choices, with improvements across the evaluated MiT scales.
blocks.zh: FuseAdapt通过FFN低级残留将模式-私人关注适应与跨模式交换区分开来. PMM以目标条件的缺失模式潜在预测来补充这一设计. 同一背骨控制支持两种选择,在经过评价的MiT尺度上都有改进.

blocks.en: Limitations and deployment scope. Absolute accuracy depends on the frozen representation and its biases; cross-backbone comparisons alone cannot isolate our contribution. Inference cost still grows with the number of sensor streams. Routing and averaging require a common projected grid, and the shift experiment measures latent prediction sensitivity, not robustness to arbitrary calibration, field-of-view, or temporal errors. The main segmentation comparisons are reported from single runs, without a statistical-significance claim. DELIVER covers predefined adverse conditions, but neither those results nor a full-context EMA target guarantees safe behavior under correlated or out-of-distribution sensor failures, including device-level ones ( Yuan et al., 2025b ; Yuan et al., 2025c ) . Deployment in robotics or driving requires application-specific testing, failure detection ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , uncertainty estimation ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , and validated fallback mechanisms.

blocks.en: Teacher and student share the same frozen initialization and architecture. Only student adaptation parameters receive gradients, and teacher adaptation parameters follow the EMA update with coefficient 0.999. PMM uses detached teacher representations rather than segmentation pseudo-labels. Full-modality input does not guarantee better predictions when a sensor is degraded. Over 1,428 MCubeS image/subset pairs (102 images and 14 proper subsets), full-input predictions improve per-image mIoU by 4.44 on average and are better in 81.72% of pairs. blocks.en:
To examine whether self-attention should apply a fused LoRA module across modalities or maintain modality-specific adaptation paths, we analyze the learned LoRA updates Δ ​ W \Delta W across both the q and v projections for each modality on two datasets, DELIVER and MCubeS.
For each projection, we also evaluate shallow, mid, and deep transformer layers and report cosine-similarity matrices.

blocks.en: E.2 Comparison with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)
blocks.zh: E.2 与专家组合的比较

blocks.en: Each FuseAdapt low-rank branch has a fixed source-sensor identity, while receiver-conditioned routing weights vary by token and input. All available sensor branches participate without top- k k selection or a load-balancing loss; absent sensors are masked. This distinguishes branch assignment from dynamic communication and does not imply fixed mixing weights. A sparse MoE-style LoRA control obtains 54.94 versus 57.62 mIoU on MCubeS. The all-path and dense-feature controls in Table 7 more directly test which activations should cross sensor streams.

blocks.en: E.3 Details of PMM.
blocks.zh: E.3 PMM的细节.

blocks.en: After the full-input warm-up, with probability 0.5 0.5 we retain all modalities; otherwise we draw independent Bernoulli- 0.5 0.5 visibility masks and enforce a nonempty visible set per sample. A target is sampled only when at least one modality is missing. The teacher always receives the full input; its designated target-modality representation is detached. blocks.en:
We train the proposed method on 8 A5000 GPUs for DELIVER, 4 for MUSES, and 4 for MCubeS. Initial learning rates are 3.5e -4 (MCubeS), 4e -4 (MUSES) and 4e -4 (DELIVER), with a 10-epoch warm-up at 0.1×.
Training is conducted for 500, 200, and 200 epochs on MCubeS, DELIVER, and MUSES respectively.
Each run begins with a warm-up stage (200 epochs for MCubeS and 15 epochs for both DELIVER and MUSES), during which the model is trained using all modalities without any masking.
We use AdamW with batch sizes of 1 (DELIVER) and 4 (MUSES, MCubeS) per GPU. Input resolutions are 1024×1024 (DELIVER, MUSES) and 512×512 (MCubeS), with standard augmentations: random resizing (0.5–2.0), flipping, color jitter, blur, and cropping.
FuseAdapt uses rank 8 for DELIVER and MCubeS, and 4 for MUSES. DINOv2-B (for DELIVER and MCubeS) [ Oquab et al., 2023 ] and DINOv2-S (MUSES) serve as the frozen VFMs.
Standard LoRA with the low-rank matrices A and B such that A is initialized with a small random Gaussian (e.g., 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 0.01 ) \mathcal{N}(0,0.01) ) and B is initialized as zero, ensuring the initial weight perturbation is zero.
The number of learnable tokens in the predictor is the same as the sequence length of the target feature.

blocks.en:
We introduce independent, modality-specific routing modules at the FFN stage to enable controlled and dynamic cross-modal fusion.
Unlike attention layers that focus on intra-modal context, these routing blocks refine each modality’s representation by selectively integrating complementary signals from others, based on the current context.
This fusion occurs after independent encoding, preventing early entanglement and allowing the model to adaptively weight modalities depending on availability, especially beneficial under modality masking. Importantly, each modality has its own dedicated routing layer, which maintains structural disentanglement and minimizes interference from masked or undertrained modalities.
blocks.zh:
我们在FFN阶段引入独立、特定模式的路由模块,以便能够进行有控制的动态跨模式聚变。
与注重模式内背景的注意层不同,这些路由区块根据当前背景,有选择地整合来自其他模式的补充信号,从而改进了每种模式的代表性。
这种聚变发生在独立编码之后,防止早期缠绕,并允许模型根据可用性进行适应性加权模式,特别是在模式遮掩下有益. 重要的是,每种模式都有自己的专用路由层,这些路由层维持结构上的分离,并尽量减少蒙蔽或未充分训练的模式的干扰。

blocks.en:
The routing module adopts a lightweight noisy gating mechanism, adapted from sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) designs.
Given hidden states, the router outputs modality-specific routing scores through a linear layer, and injects learned Gaussian noise via a second linear layer followed by softplus. The input size matches the feature dimension of the VFM output, while the output size corresponds to the number of training modalities. The resulting noisy logits enable soft, differentiable expert selection.
Routers are trained end-to-end as part of the main optimization, without any additional loss terms.
blocks.zh:
路由模块采用了一种轻量级的噪声吉卜赛机制,由很少启用的Mixture-of-Experts(MoE)设计而来.
鉴于隐藏状态,路由器通过线性层输出特定模式的路由分数,然后通过第二线性层注入学到的高斯噪音,然后是软加. 输入大小与VFM输出的特征维度相符,而输出大小则与培训模式的数量相符. 由此产生的吵闹的对数可以使软的,不同的专家选择成为可能.
路由器作为主优化的一部分被训练成端到端,不附加任何损失条款.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the effectiveness of routing mechanisms. As shown in Table 18 , incorporating routing fusion into the FFNs consistently improves performance.
When no fusion is applied (“without routing”), the model processes each modality independently and therefore cannot benefit from cross-modal interactions.
Using a simple average fusion yields only marginal gains, as it assumes that all modalities contribute equally and ignores their heterogeneous characteristics.
In contrast, routing fusion adaptively selects and combines modality-dependent FFN experts, leading to a clear improvement (from 56.09 to 57.62 mIoU).
This demonstrates that learned routing effectively captures the distinct roles that different modalities play in multi-modal feature refinement.
We also observe that a shared router yields a competitive gain (57.24 mIoU), showing that routing is helpful even without modality-specific specialization.
blocks.zh:
我们评价路线机制的有效性。 如表18所示,将路由核聚变纳入福尔多涅系统,不断提高性能。
在不采用聚变法(“没有路由法”)时,模型会独立处理每种模式,因此无法从跨模式互动中受益。
使用简单的平均聚变只产生边际收益,因为它假定所有方式都平等贡献,而忽略了它们的多样性。
相比之下,路由核聚变则因地制宜地选择和结合了依赖模式的FFN专家,导致明显的改进(从56.09 mIoU).
这表明,学到的路由方法有效地抓住了不同模式在改进多式联运特征方面发挥的独特作用。
我们还注意到,共享路由器产生竞争收益(57.24 mIoU),表明即使没有特定模式的专门化,路由也是有益的.

blocks.en:
Notably, unlike Mixture of Experts structures that perform token-level dynamic expert selection (e.g., top-K gating), our routing deterministically assigns each LoRA expert to a specific modality.
All available modality branches participate without top- k k selection or a load-balancing objective. Mixing weights remain token-dependent, and absent sources are masked before normalization.
blocks.zh:
值得注意的是,与执行符号级动态专家选择(例如顶级-K型)的专家结构混合不同,我们的路线确定性地将每个LORA专家分配到特定模式.
所有可用的模式分支都参与其中,没有上- k 选择或负载平衡目标. 混合重量仍然依赖象征性的重量,不存在的来源在正常化前被掩盖.

The memory cost, including optimizer states under AdamW (in float32 type and without AMP), is 16.90 MB, and the computational cost is 4.8 GFLOPs, representing only 0.55% of the total model FLOPs (873.96 GFLOPs).

blocks.en:
Although the cost of FuseAdapt grows linearly with the number of modalities, the relative overhead on parameters, memory, and computation remains very small.
These figures describe adaptation-module overhead, not the total cost of processing an additional sensor through the frozen encoder. End-to-end deployment measurements are reported in Appendix D .

虽然FuseAdapt的成本随着模式的数量而呈线性增长,但参数,内存和计算方面的相对间接费用仍然很小.
这些数字说明了适应模块的间接费用,而不是通过冷冻编码器处理额外传感器的总成本。 端到端部署量度见附录D。
